Consigliato 0,5 con il database completo: Recommended 0.5 with the full database (K4 calibration on simulated cured-meat communities, confirmed on the Zymo sample) and 0.1 with the quick screening: for reduced databases between 0.05 and 0.30 is recommended (Wright, Comeau and Langille 2023).
Vale solo per Kraken: MetaPhlAn non ha s: Applies to Kraken only: MetaPhlAn has no threshold and shows all the species. Recommended 0.1 % with the full database (K4 calibration) and 0.005 % with the quick screening (Edwin et al. 2024, soil samples). The species below the threshold stay in the Excel file.
Bracken stima una specie solo se ha alme: Bracken estimates a species only if it has at least these reads. 10 is the Bracken default (Lu et al. 2017): higher removes rare species and false positives, lower keeps more of them.
Deve corrispondere alla lunghezza delle: It must match the read length of the sequencing: 150 for most of today's Illumina reads.
Pochi secondi a campione, ma può perdere: A few seconds per sample, but it can miss species between 0.1 and 1 %, lactic acid bacteria too. Useful for a first look.
Sempre incluso. Profilo delle specie con: Always included. Species profile with MetaPhlAn (in 6 parts, to fit in 16 GB) and with Kraken.
